name: @xmd/web
description: Resolve XMD notes as static HTML or interactive widgets using the shared Rust engine

scripts.gif: npm run gif:typing && npm run gif:terminal
scripts.gif:typing: node scripts/typing-gif.mjs --theme light && node scripts/typing-gif.mjs --theme dark
scripts.gif:terminal: node scripts/terminal-gif.mjs --theme light && node scripts/terminal-gif.mjs --theme dark
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:types && playwright test
